notes: Only 18 entries from opened pages. No official duty rota or animal poison line found for Pakistan (PVMC page lists no clinics; provincial livestock departments, PMAS Arid Agriculture, Sindh Agriculture University (SAU AHVS page opened, no clinic phone/address) and Karachi university hospitals not verified). WebFetch refusals (skipped, not worked around): healthytailsanimalhospital.com (robots_disallowed), gvhospital.com (robots_disallowed); errors: petplanethospital.com, thevetsanimal.com, veterinby.com. Facebook/Instagram-only clinics not fetched. Leads for next run (not opened): Aliyan Pets Hospital (Karachi/Islamabad, 24/7 per directory only), Healthy Paws Pet Hospital Karachi, Vet Care Pets Hospital Islamabad (24/7 emergency per wa.me listing), Pets Care N Cure Karachi (page fetch returned unrelated content), Pet Planet Hospital Karachi. No coverage yet of Quetta, Peshawar beyond one clinic, Murree/Gilgit/Hunza/Swat tourist areas, Hyderabad, Sialkot.
